features.name: Real-Time Operational Dashboard
features.description: Display real-time operational dashboard with key metrics updated every 60 seconds, including fleet status, active rentals, revenue tracking, utilization metrics, and system health

requirementDetails.userStory: As a Fleet Manager, I want real-time visibility into fleet status, active rentals, and utilization metrics, so that I can make immediate operational decisions and respond quickly to issues
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays with metrics updated at least every 60 seconds
Fleet status overview with vehicle counts by status
Active rentals monitoring with current count and activity
Revenue tracking with today's, WTD, MTD comparisons
Utilization metrics by vehicle category and location
System health metrics including API response times and error rates
Geographic heat maps for demand/supply distribution
Customizable dashboard widgets via drag-and-drop
Save dashboard customizations per user role and individual
Drill-down capability from metrics to detailed views

features.name: Customer Analytics and Insights
features.description: Detailed analytics on customer behavior, preferences, lifetime value (LTV), acquisition cost (CAC), retention metrics, booking patterns, geographic analysis, and conversion funnel with churn risk identification

workflowContext.workflow: Booking Creation Workflow, User Management Workflow

requirementDetails.userStory: As a Marketing Manager, I want detailed analytics on customer behavior, preferences, and lifetime value, so that I can optimize marketing spend and target high-value segments
acceptanceCriteria: Segment customers by behavior, value, demographics, rental patterns
Calculate customer LTV based on historical data and predict future value
Track CAC by marketing channel
Calculate retention metrics including churn rate and repeat rental rate
Analyze booking patterns including preferred categories and lead times
Provide geographic analysis of customer distribution and preferences
Analyze conversion funnel metrics at each step
Flag at-risk customers when churn risk exceeds threshold
Identify high-value customer segments based on LTV
Provide marketing optimization recommendations

features.name: Predictive Analytics and Forecasting
features.description: AI-powered demand forecasting, pricing recommendations, maintenance cost predictions, churn risk identification, revenue forecasting with confidence intervals, seasonal pattern detection, and external factor integration with model explainability

workflowContext.workflow: Pricing Updates Workflow, Fleet Management Workflow

requirementDetails.userStory: As an Executive, I want AI-powered demand forecasting and predictive insights, so that I can make proactive strategic decisions and optimize pricing and fleet planning
acceptanceCriteria: Use ML algorithms to predict rental demand by location, category, time
Provide AI-driven pricing recommendations based on demand forecasts
Forecast maintenance costs and timing based on telematics data
Identify customers at risk of churning with intervention recommendations
Predict future revenue with confidence intervals
Identify and quantify seasonal demand patterns automatically
Integrate external factors (weather, events, holidays) into predictions
Alert administrators when forecast accuracy falls below threshold
Continuously improve prediction accuracy through model retraining
Provide explainability for AI recommendations showing key factors

features.name: Automated Report Generation
features.description: Automatically generate and distribute reports on scheduled intervals with pre-built templates, custom report builder, multi-format export (PDF, Excel, CSV, PowerPoint, JSON), email distribution, API access, and retention policies

requirementDetails.userStory: As a System Administrator, I want to automatically generate and distribute reports on scheduled intervals, so that stakeholders receive timely information without manual effort
acceptanceCriteria: Provide pre-built report templates for common reports
Provide drag-and-drop custom report builder
Allow scheduling with configurable frequency (daily, weekly, monthly, etc.)
Support multi-format export (PDF, Excel, CSV, PowerPoint, JSON)
Automatically email reports to configured distribution lists
Store generated reports for on-demand access via dashboard
Provide API access to report data for programmatic integration
Send failure notification and retry when scheduled report fails
Apply configurable retention policies to archive/delete old reports
Log all report generation and distribution activities for audit

features.name: System Performance Metrics
features.description: Monitor technical performance metrics including API/page load response times (p50, p95, p99), error rates, uptime/downtime, database performance, infrastructure metrics (CPU, memory, disk, network), automated alerting, and integration with external monitoring tools

requirementDetails.userStory: As an Engineering Manager, I want to monitor technical performance metrics, so that I can proactively detect and resolve performance issues
acceptanceCriteria: Track API and page load response times with p50, p95, p99 percentiles
Monitor error rates by endpoint and error type
Track system uptime and downtime with root cause analysis
Monitor database performance including query performance and connection pool usage
Track infrastructure metrics including CPU, memory, disk, network utilization
Provide automated alerting for performance degradation based on configurable thresholds
Maintain historical performance trends for long-term analysis
Trigger alerts to engineering teams when response times exceed thresholds
Provide performance dashboards showing real-time and historical metrics
Integrate with external monitoring tools via standard protocols (Prometheus, StatsD)

features.name: Business KPI Tracking
features.description: Track critical business KPIs including booking metrics, revenue metrics, customer metrics, operational metrics with goal tracking, trend analysis, comparative analysis (DoD, WoW, MoM, YoY), alerts for deviations, executive summary dashboards, and custom KPI definitions

requirementDetails.userStory: As an Executive, I want to track critical business KPIs with goal tracking and trend analysis, so that I can monitor business health and progress toward objectives
acceptanceCriteria: Track booking metrics including bookings per hour/day/week and conversion rate
Track revenue metrics including revenue per hour/day/week and average booking value
Track customer metrics including new registrations, active users, retention rate
Track operational metrics including vehicle utilization, turnaround time, on-time pickup rate
Allow users to set and track progress toward business goals with visual progress indicators
Provide trend analysis identifying patterns and anomalies in KPIs
Enable comparative analysis between current and previous periods (DoD, WoW, MoM, YoY)
Alert relevant stakeholders when KPIs deviate significantly from targets
Provide executive summary dashboards with high-level KPI visualization
Support custom KPI definitions based on business-specific metrics

features.name: Competitive Benchmarking
features.description: Monitor competitor pricing, inventory availability, market share estimation, customer sentiment analysis, feature launches, promotional activity, emerging market trends, competitive positioning reports, and integration with third-party market intelligence platforms

requirementDetails.userStory: As a Strategy Manager, I want to track competitor pricing and market share, so that I can maintain competitive positioning and identify market opportunities
acceptanceCriteria: Monitor competitor pricing across vehicle categories and locations
Track competitor inventory availability and utilization patterns
Estimate market share by location and customer segment
Analyze competitor customer sentiment from reviews and ratings
Track competitor feature launches and new capabilities
Monitor competitor promotional activity and discount patterns
Identify emerging market trends and opportunities based on competitive intelligence
Provide competitive positioning reports comparing platform performance to competitors
Alert stakeholders to significant competitive moves or market changes
Integrate with third-party market intelligence platforms via API

features.name: Data Monetization Analytics
features.description: Analyze and package anonymized fleet data for monetization including traffic patterns, vehicle performance data for manufacturers, market insights, driving behavior for insurance, urban mobility insights, data asset inventory, privacy-compliant anonymization, API access, and ROI tracking

requirementDetails.userStory: As a Chief Data Officer, I want to analyze and package anonymized fleet data for monetization, so that I can create new revenue streams from data assets
acceptanceCriteria: Aggregate and anonymize fleet data, usage patterns, market insights for external use
Analyze traffic patterns, popular routes, parking demand from telematics data
Package vehicle performance data for automotive manufacturers
Provide market insights including demand patterns, customer preferences, pricing elasticity
Analyze driving behavior patterns for insurance actuarial analysis
Generate urban mobility insights for city planning and transportation authorities
Identify valuable data assets and revenue opportunities through data asset inventory
Ensure all data monetization complies with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) through anonymization and aggregation
Provide API access to data products for third-party consumers
Track data monetization revenue and ROI on data collection investments

features.name: Search Performance and User Experience
features.description: Fast search results (<2s), quick filter updates (<500ms), debounced search input (300ms), progressive image loading, lazy loading with infinite scroll/pagination, result caching, optimistic UI updates, loading skeletons, result count display, helpful no-results message, mobile performance optimization, sub-second database queries, and scroll position preservation

sources.section: Requirement VS-12: Search Performance and User Experience

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want fast and responsive search experience, so that I can find vehicles quickly without frustration
acceptanceCriteria: Display search results within 2 seconds of search execution
Update filtered results within 500 milliseconds of filter application
Implement debounced search input with 300ms delay to reduce unnecessary queries
Use progressive image loading with placeholders for vehicle photos
Implement lazy loading of search results using infinite scroll or pagination
Cache search results for back navigation to avoid re-querying
Provide optimistic UI updates for perceived performance
Display loading skeletons during data fetching
Show search result count prominently
Display helpful 'No results' message with suggestions when no results found
Maintain search performance on mobile devices with slower connections
Optimize database queries for sub-second response times
Implement search result pagination with configurable page size
Preserve scroll position when returning to search results from vehicle details

features.name: Error Handling and Recovery
features.description: Helpful no-results message with alternative suggestions (dates, locations), error messages for failed/timeout searches, preserve search criteria for retry, retry option and alternative search method, invalid criteria highlighting with specific errors, prevent search execution until corrected, provide valid input examples, price change notifications, suggest similar vehicles when unavailable, customer support contact info, and error logging

sources.section: Requirement VS-19: Error Handling and Recovery

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want clear error messages and recovery options, so that I can resolve issues and complete my search successfully
acceptanceCriteria: Display helpful message with alternative suggestions when no vehicles available for search criteria
Suggest alternative dates showing availability calendar when no vehicles available
Suggest nearby locations with availability when no vehicles available
Display error message explaining the issue when search query fails or times out
Preserve user's search criteria for retry when search fails
Provide retry option and alternative search method when search fails
Highlight invalid fields with specific error messages when user enters invalid search criteria
Prevent search execution until corrected when user enters invalid criteria
Provide examples of valid input when user enters invalid criteria
Display notification with old and new prices when price changes between search and booking
Suggest similar available vehicles when selected vehicle becomes unavailable
Provide customer support contact information when errors occur
Log errors for debugging and improvement purposes

features.name: Performance Optimization
features.description: Cache geocoding results for frequent addresses, cache static map images, cache route calculations for common pairs, implement client-side map tile caching, use CDN for map assets, batch geocoding requests, use static maps where appropriate, implement lazy loading for map components, debounce autocomplete requests, and monitor/optimize cache hit rates

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want optimized mapping service usage, so that costs are minimized and performance is maximized
acceptanceCriteria: Cache geocoding results for frequently searched addresses
Cache static map images for reuse
Cache route calculations for common origin-destination pairs
Implement client-side caching for map tiles
Use CDN for serving map assets
Batch geocoding requests when possible
Use static maps instead of interactive maps where appropriate
Implement lazy loading for map components
Debounce autocomplete requests to reduce API calls
Monitor cache hit rates and optimize caching strategy

features.name: Error Handling and Fallbacks
features.description: Provide fallback for GPS failure, display cached maps when API unavailable, show user-friendly error messages, implement retry logic for transient failures, allow manual address entry when geocoding fails, provide text-based directions when map rendering fails, monitor service availability and alert operations, degrade gracefully to list view, cache critical location data for offline access, and log errors for debugging

requirementDetails.userStory: As a customer, I want the system to work even when mapping services are unavailable, so that I can complete my booking without disruption
acceptanceCriteria: Provide fallback for location detection when GPS fails
Display cached maps when mapping API is unavailable
Show user-friendly error messages for mapping failures
Implement retry logic for transient mapping API failures
Allow manual address entry when geocoding fails
Provide text-based directions when map rendering fails
Monitor mapping service availability and alert operations team
Degrade gracefully to list view when map view fails
Cache critical location data for offline access
Log mapping errors for debugging and service improvement

features.name: Notification Templates
features.description: Create reusable templates for each notification type with dynamic content placeholders, template versioning for A/B testing and rollback, multi-language support, preview and testing tools, validation before deployment, performance metrics tracking, channel-specific customization, template library with categorization, and approval workflow for changes

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want reusable notification templates, so that messaging is consistent and easy to maintain across channels
acceptanceCriteria: Create templates for each notification type
Support dynamic content placeholders (customer name, booking reference, amount)
Version templates for A/B testing and rollback
Support multi-language templates
Provide template preview and testing tools
Validate templates before deployment
Track template performance metrics
Allow template customization per channel (email, SMS, push)
Maintain template library with categorization
Require approval workflow for template changes

features.name: Event-Driven Notification Architecture
features.description: Publish notification events to message queue (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, Kafka), consume events asynchronously, process in background workers, implement retry logic for failures, use dead letter queue for permanent failures, handle notification spikes without blocking business logic, guarantee at-least-once delivery for critical notifications, prevent duplicates through idempotency, monitor queue depth and lag, and scale workers based on queue depth

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform developer, I want notifications decoupled from business logic, so that the system is scalable and reliable
acceptanceCriteria: Publish notification events to message queue (RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, Kafka)
Consume notification events asynchronously
Process notifications in background workers
Implement retry logic for failed deliveries
Use dead letter queue for permanently failed notifications
Handle notification spikes without blocking business logic
Guarantee at-least-once delivery for critical notifications
Prevent duplicate notification sending through idempotency
Monitor queue depth and processing lag
Scale notification workers based on queue depth

features.name: Notification Analytics
features.description: Track delivery rate, open rate (email/push), click rate, bounce rate (email/SMS), unsubscribe rate by type, conversion rate (notification to booking), provide analytics dashboard with visualizations, support filtering by date/channel/type, set up anomaly alerts (sudden drop in delivery rate), and export analytics data for external analysis

requirementDetails.userStory: As a marketing team member, I want to track notification performance metrics, so that I can optimize messaging and improve engagement
acceptanceCriteria: Track delivery rate for each notification channel
Track open rate for email and push notifications
Track click rate for notifications with links
Track bounce rate for email and SMS
Track unsubscribe rate by notification type
Track conversion rate (notification → booking)
Provide analytics dashboard with visualizations
Support filtering metrics by date range, channel, and type
Set up alerts for anomalies (sudden drop in delivery rate)
Export analytics data for external analysis
